candidates.change_summary: Replace the assignment to acc.unlockTime so Put always sets unlockTime to block.timestamp + _unlockTime (treating _unlockTime as a delay), changing stored unlockTime.
Replace the assignment to acc.unlockTime so Put always sets unlockTime to block.timestamp (ignoring _unlockTime), changing stored unlockTime.
Replace the assignment to acc.unlockTime so Put sets unlockTime to _unlockTime directly (no max with block.timestamp), changing stored unlockTime when _unlockTime is in the past.
Delete the assignment to acc.unlockTime so Put no longer updates unlockTime, leaving previous value unchanged.
Replace the LogFile.AddMessage call with a different log string so observed log messages differ after Put.
Change the withdrawal condition from strict '>' on unlockTime to '>=' so users can collect when block.timestamp equals unlockTime.
Remove the MinSum check so any nonzero balance can be collected if other conditions hold.
Change subtraction to set balance to zero after transfer (draining entire account regardless of _am).
Move the state update after external call: perform call first then subtract _am from balance (introduces reentrancy change).
Change the external call to transfer using send pattern: use payable(msg.sender).transfer(_am) instead of call, altering gas/behavior on failure.
